title: What my Rocketlane spec forgot: 28/28 checks passed, 18 gaps found #shorts
description:
Claude built a Rocketlane alternative, a client onboarding tracker where every client gets their own read-only link, from one written spec: all 28 acceptance checks passed, and the build exposed 18 gaps in the spec. The most surprising one: the morning digest named only the client, so once a client had two projects nobody could tell which one was late. Real sign-in, real email delivery and a real scheduler were not tested.

Full build test (2:46): https://youtu.be/8o02hhUDQ5s
The free spec: https://personalsoftwarefactory.com/blueprints/client-onboarding-tracker
Rocketlane pricing and alternatives: https://personalsoftwarefactory.com/alternatives/rocketlane

Made with AI: Sam's on-camera hook and outro are an AI avatar of him, and the narration is his AI voice clone (HeyGen). The product footage is from the real test build.
